Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment (PXD009338) specifically focuses on the AP-MS survey of seven different MLL-fusion proteins. While the paper describes subsequent SETD2 knockdown and DOT1L inhibition experiments, these are validated via Western Blot, qPCR, and RNA-seq, not the primary MS dataset. The MS analysis is a comparison of prey proteins enriched by different MLL-fusion baits versus control purifications.
